arguments.title: Incident practice: April 2023 metrics-router cutover canary
arguments.body:
## Case study

On April 7, 2023, around 2:30 PM ET, an info-level canary alert surfaced during the metrics-router cutover. The canary triggered an automatic rollback; investigation traced the regression to the batch window on the OpenTelemetry (OTel) collector. The responder redeployed cleanly, and the system was healthy again within four hours. This was not a page—the canary and rollback behaved as intended, limiting the issue while the cause was investigated.

## Responder discussion

1. What evidence would you check first to distinguish a metrics-router regression from an OTel collector batching issue?
2. Once the rollback restores health, what checks would you require before redeploying and resuming the cutover?
